b: On the last day in Hanoi we took an apartment… Turned out he'd set up a whole lot of puzzles just to open it.. When we somehow got in, it was a five-storey apartment… All five floors just for us… A bed on every floor… We ran and looked at everything, and finally while the four of us fought over the ground-floor bed, Thushara went upstairs and slept…

Then we went through all the money accounts and sat talking..Sing Keeth would go to Singapore the next day.. After this we'd all meet again only after a while.. Talking about everything, we fell asleep..

The next morning Thushara, Dhanush and I got up early and set off for Hanoi airport… With the sadness of leaving Vietnam.. the sadness of the journey ending, with all of it we went to the airport..There we took a flight and landed in Thailand

We had to stay 10 hours in Thailand.. Since it was a free visa we thought we'd look around… But we'd gone into the transit building by mistake.. Now we couldn't go out either .. and if we wanted to eat something we'd have to change money again…This won't work, I said, and ate the chips I'd hidden away.. Dhanush didn't even do that..

While we were there, news came that there was rain and a storm in Sri Lanka… It got dark at the Thailand airport too.. As news came that lots of flights were delayed, I thought, that's it for us… Thank God nothing happened.. The flight came on time

Only when we landed in Colombo did we understand that, whatever else, the smell of your own soil is something special…Seeing our languages, Sinhala and Tamil, and the people who speak them, a feeling I can't name.. A sense of acceptance comes…As soon as I got home by Uber and ate pittu with curd and kuzhambu,
as the old song goes, even heaven can't match home…
note: Pittu is steamed rice flour and coconut, a Jaffna staple; kuzhambu is a tangy curry.
